correctness.rationale: A graph cover lifts tree components to disjoint trees and cyclically reduced base cycles to closed nonbacktracking cycles after a finite number of lifts. Therefore orbit forests exactly equal forest subsets of the quotient, including loop/digon obstructions. Orbit-barycentric coordinates prove PL homeomorphism. Theorem 1.3 of arxiv:1410.3870 and the cited Tutte wedge formula give integral homotopy, while the reduced Lefschetz equality gives the sign. Exact exhaustive signed-chain computations reproduce all test cases including the noncyclic Klein-four group; the one-vertex augmented boundary is explicitly covered.
